log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed 11 (all criminals shown) quick entries in morning. Watch pool size in press conferences; caught if pool <=1000 at end of day. Strategy: kill many per day to reach 30 in 5 days for multipliers, but traced deaths narrow the pool. National victims are safe. Prefer national and items reported in many places? Unknown.

Day 2: killed 8 (national, hospital, South, 2 foreign, forum, 2 radio), all quick/morning. Day 1 actual record: only 1 kill (national), so total deaths so far 9 after day 2. Plan: spread kills across places so no place gets 3 traced victims; watch press conferences for deaths_traced and pool drop. Pool must stay >1000. Need 30 deaths in 5 days for x2, 40 for x4. Night worker: use quick entries in morning/afternoon.

Day 3: killed national d3-10 plus 4 minor spread across places (1 each: forum, radio, South, hospital, foreign) using quick/morning. Total deaths so far about 9+6=15. Pool dropped to 40000 after day 2 with 2 traced; be careful: avoid concentrating kills in any one place (3 traced in same place triggers L). Keep pool >1000. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days for x2; consider ramping up later when safe. Night worker: quick entries in morning/afternoon.

Day 4: killed national d4-2 only (quick/morning) to stay safe. Pool 40000 after day 3 with 4 traced; L can trace 5 deaths/day at random, so fewer deaths means fewer traces. Avoid concentrating in one place (3 traced in same place triggers L). Keep pool above 1000. Night worker: quick entries in morning/afternoon. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days; probably not worth risking exposure.
